sentence: This project studies how snake teeth are replaced and how blood vessels and nerves keep their connections to the teeth.
This project builds learning methods that improve the robustness and fairness of deep learning models.
This project supports a conference where researchers share work on systems, control, decision-making, and automation.
This project builds a platform that applies mechanical forces to single cells to see how cells respond and pass signals to neighboring cells.
This project builds machine learning models that answer questions about what is visible in satellite, drone, and ground imagery.
This project builds a platform of course materials, software tools, and real-world datasets for teaching cybersecurity.
This project builds a robotics training program with modules on assembling, programming, and troubleshooting.
This project builds a platform where bacteria display enzymes on the surface of spores, then improves those enzymes through directed evolution.
This project studies how American pikas have responded to changing environments across space and time, using museum specimens and whole genome sequencing.
This project builds computer models that simulate how DNA nanostructures assemble, and uses them to improve nanostructure designs.
This project builds machine learning methods that combine several types of biological data to predict phenotypes.
This project builds a network of instructors and a shared online collection of lab activities that use CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing.
This project studies how environmental conditions shape where freshwater invertebrates and their parasites live, and why some hosts resist parasite infections.
This project builds a computational framework that uses imaging data to measure the mechanical properties of extracellular vesicles.
